page.layout: One page of text, with a decorative woodcut band above the title; title block centred at top; then a verse poem in two columns of text in the body, with a large decorative initial; left margin shows truncated text edges (not notes); right margin has no notes. Page number at top right.

main_text.l: Ter beatus, qui procul atriis Regum
superbis, atque procul fori Clamore rauci, bobus arat suis Agros paternos liðaque prædia.

l.i: invida Morsus fatigat. Non rutilum expetens
Sit non lauta quærit fercula, necque
Et cocta paruis rapa focis, famem

page.notes: Woodcut initial "O" at start of the poem; several words are in doubtful or damaged print (e.g. "liðaque", "Sfum", "Sorat", "Vua", "Ua", "Liuus", "Vitim", "Illi"), and the text at the left edge is cropped. Transcription of these is uncertain.
